CustomField.description: Auto-set TRUE by F-14 when Quote is contracted in USD but BAN bills in local currency. Triggers SBI_Flag__c. Passed in IP-1 FX Arrangement group.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Checked automatically when the quote is priced in USD but the billing account invoices in local currency. Triggers an SBI flag and requires FX Rate Model to be completed.
CustomField.label: FX Billing Required
